_comment: Curated meaning + POPULATION of the STS tables, read by the agent's describe_table tool (ADR 0010). Facts verified against the Oct 2026 datasource; owner review requested for 'population' lines. Never put real data values here.

schools.meaning: One row per school (10 in the datasource). Holds the province/district used for every geographic breakdown.
schools.population: All schools. No deleted_at column — do NOT add a deleted_at filter on schools.
notes: Province of a school is schools.province; cases.address_province is the student's HOME province, a different thing.

student_term.meaning: One row per ENROLLMENT of a student in an academic term (student_uuid). A person can have several.
student_term.population: All enrollments incl. historical (~6,010). For the 'current student' count use student_current_enrollment_resolution, not this table alone.
notes: Contains personal names, address, coordinates — never select them (analytics only).

student_person.meaning: One row per real person (identity); distinct from an enrollment.
student_person.population: All persons ever registered (~6,510), including merged/duplicate identities.
notes: COUNT(DISTINCT person_uuid) counts people; COUNT(DISTINCT student_uuid) counts enrollments.

student_current_enrollment_resolution.meaning: View deciding which enrollment is a person's current one per term.
student_current_enrollment_resolution.population: One row per person per term (~6,010). resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' means the person counts as a current student.
notes: Canonical source of 'นักเรียนปัจจุบัน'. Do not substitute student_status codes.

student_risk_profiles.meaning: Snapshot of every assessed student's risk level and the attendance figures that drive it.
student_risk_profiles.population: ALL assessed students (~5,987; ~610 are HIGH or WATCH), regardless of whether a case was opened. This is the population behind 'นักเรียนกลุ่มเสี่ยง'.
notes: risk_tier is a risk LEVEL (HIGH/WATCH/NORMAL), not a cause. Never present a comparison between tiers as the cause of risk.

For 'สาเหตุของความเสี่ยง / ทำไมเสี่ยง / ทำไมจังหวัด X น่าเป็นห่วง': count HIGH students (current enrollment, ACTIVE schools — the same population as the risk ranking) per factor (no % sign inside string literals: write ร้อยละ — a bare % breaks execution) whose profile breaches the alert thresholds: attendance_rate_percent < 80, consecutive_absent_days >= 3, term_absent_days >= 7, late_count > 0. One row per factor (Thai label first), plus high_risk_total and recorded_signal_count (case_risk_signals for the same slice). In the message call these 'ปัจจัยที่พบ', not the reason the system recorded.
It is a snapshot: report profile_calculated_at when freshness matters.

cases.meaning: Follow-up cases opened for students (one row per case).
cases.population: Only students for whom a case was opened (~163 cases, ~162 students) — a small subset of at-risk students.
notes: Three different 'cause' questions, by stage: (1) 'สาเหตุของความเสี่ยง / ทำไมเสี่ยง' = factors in student_risk_profiles of HIGH students (before any case); (2) 'ระบบแจ้งเตือน / เปิดเคสเพราะอะไร' = cases.reason_flagged (why a case was opened), with case_risk_signals as the rule-level detail; (3) 'ติดตาม / เยี่ยมบ้านแล้วพบสาเหตุอะไร' = task_submissions problem category / absence reason (found by the follow-up). Answer the stage the question names.
Holds student name/address columns — never select them. Do not substitute cases.risk_tier for student_risk_profiles.risk_tier.

Stage (2) case-opening reason: reason_flagged is free text with a number; normalise it with starts_with(c.reason_flagged, '<prefix>') (not LIKE — a bare % breaks execution): 'ขาดเรียนหลังปิดเคสล่าสุด' → 'ขาดเรียนซ้ำหลังปิดเคส', 'ขาดเรียนสะสม', 'ขาดเรียนติดต่อกัน', 'เวลาเรียนต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์', ELSE 'อื่น ๆ (ครูระบุเอง)'. For case-opening REASONS count all cases incl. soft-deleted ones (deleted cases are still OPEN, never resolved — a product decision kept so reason/signal counts match across questions). Never output reason_flagged raw: teachers may write names in it.

For HOW MANY cases were opened (per school / province / status) exclude soft-deleted cases: WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL (134 of 173 cases are deleted; deleted ≠ resolved — resolution is status = 'RESOLVED'). Count from cases itself, not from student_risk_profiles, and do not restrict to HIGH students unless the question says so. Put case_count as the first numeric column.

case_risk_signals.meaning: The system's recorded REASONS a student was flagged: each row is one rule-triggered signal with its source system (signal_source_code, e.g. SUBJECT_RISK_MONITOR), the rule that fired (signal_rule_code, e.g. LOW_ATTENDANCE_PERCENT, MIXED_SUBJECT_ABSENCE, TERM_ABSENCE_ACCUMULATION, SUBJECT_AVOIDANCE_PERCENT) and a Thai explanation with the thresholds (signal_reason).
case_risk_signals.population: Signals attached to opened cases only (~11 signals across ~7 cases). Small coverage: say so in the answer.
notes: Stage (2) detail: signals are the alert rules that fired on opened cases (~11 in total). A general 'สาเหตุของความเสี่ยง' question is answered from student_risk_profiles (stage 1) with this count alongside as recorded_signal_count; a 'why was the case opened' question from cases.reason_flagged (see cases notes).

Answer from this table alone only when the question asks specifically for the reasons the SYSTEM RECORDED / the alert rules ('เหตุผลที่ระบบบันทึก', 'กฎที่แจ้งเตือน'): GROUP BY signal_rule_code with a Thai label first: CASE signal_rule_code WHEN 'LOW_ATTENDANCE_PERCENT' THEN 'เวลาเรียนต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์' WHEN 'MIXED_SUBJECT_ABSENCE' THEN 'โดดคาบ' WHEN 'TERM_ABSENCE_ACCUMULATION' THEN 'ขาดสะสมต่อเทอม' WHEN 'SUBJECT_AVOIDANCE_PERCENT' THEN 'เลี่ยงวิชาเดิม' ELSE signal_rule_code END AS cause.
Select signal_source_code only when the question asks about the source system ('แหล่งที่มา / ระบบไหน'); today every signal has the same source.
Do not filter cases.deleted_at when counting signals: 10 of 11 signals sit on soft-deleted (still OPEN) cases; they are kept on purpose so cause counts match across questions.

case_referrals.meaning: Referrals of a case to an outside agency.

tasks.meaning: Home-visit / assistance tasks created from cases.
notes: Submissions cannot be joined back to a task or case (the task_links table is not readable).

task_assistance_measures.meaning: Assistance measure codes attached to a task (one row per task × measure).
task_assistance_measures.population: Tasks with recorded measures only (~16 rows; mostly empty).

task_submissions.meaning: Field submissions (home-visit results) — readable on its own, not joinable to task/case.
notes: Use it for counts by month/outcome/problem category only. Never select addresses, coordinates or free-text detail columns.

Stage (3) cause found by follow-up: count by follow_up_problem_categories.label_th or by absence_reasons.label_th (+ category), WHERE deleted_at IS NULL; show unset codes as 'ไม่ได้ระบุ'. It cannot be sliced by province/school/case (no readable link) — say so when the question asks for one.

Real/root cause found on the home visit (ยากจน, พ่อแม่หย่าร้าง, ใกล้แหล่งยาเสพติด …) — NOT cases.reason_flagged (that is why the case was opened). UNION ALL the findings: disadvantage_types (skip NONE), parental_status_options (skip LIVING_TOGETHER/UNKNOWN), residence_environment_options (skip NORMAL/OTHER), disability_types (skip NONE), absence_reasons (skip UNKNOWN); output finding, finding_group, COUNT(DISTINCT task_submission_id) AS home_visit_count, only submissions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL.

attendance_day.meaning: View: one row per student per day with the day-level attendance status.
attendance_day.population: Recorded student-days (~30,425). Source of truth for attendance rate, absent days, consecutive absence.
notes: Attendance rate denominator = days with status <> 4; present = status IN (1, 3).

attendance_effective_records.meaning: View: one row per student per attendance SESSION (period).
notes: Use for session-grain questions only; use attendance_day for per-day rates.

attendance_subject_day.meaning: View: one row per student per subject per day.

attendance_sessions.meaning: One row per attendance-taking session (class period).
notes: Count sessions with COUNT(DISTINCT attendance_sessions.id).

school_classrooms.meaning: Classrooms of a school in one term.

school_terms.meaning: Academic year + semester of a school.
school_terms.population: School-terms (~11). status = 'ACTIVE' is the current term per school.
notes: Academic year comes from academic_year, never from the Gregorian year + 543.
Holds names, citizen id, phone, email — personal data: count only, never select personal columns.

school_teacher_memberships.meaning: A teacher's membership in a school over time.
notes: Present-tense questions ('ครูที่สอนอยู่') need the ACTIVE membership status.
